note: The shapes the benchmark fixture can build. docs/13 §Performance Engineering Process names this slot 'CI graph shapes, ticket volumes, time-series, vectors'; the graph shapes are here, and the ticket, time-series and vector shapes are named in bench/README.md as work that is not built yet.

w3.label: W3 shape
w3.note: The shape docs/13 §Workload Model gives the enterprise workload: a CI graph at fan-out 12, deep enough to reach the traversal depth cap of 5. 250 CIs, 249 edges.

wide.label: breadth-cap shape
wide.note: Wide enough that the reachable set from the spine head passes the budget's 5,000-node cap, so a traversal has to truncate and say that it did.
